main.description: One week's Pet of the Week, held in the publisher's repo. The record key is the ISO week (e.g. 2026-W39), so there is exactly one per week and every step that writes it is idempotent. ⚠ ONLY THE PUBLISHER'S COPY COUNTS. The index refuses this collection from any other repo, because eligibility, the ribbon and the badge all read it.

keeper.description: The featured keeper. Absent only when status is skipped because nobody was eligible.

passedOver.description: Keepers picked for this week and then replaced, because they declined or had withdrawn consent. They are not picked again for 12 weeks.

pet.description: The featured pet, in the keeper's repo. Absent exactly when keeper is.

post.description: The Bluesky post, once there is one.

week.description: The ISO week, the same as the record key.
